chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), he said shortly before his death, in the manner of a will, when Ibn Muljam struck him, may Allah curse him.

key_terms.ابْنُ مِلْجَمَ: Ibn Muljam, the assassin of Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's final will before his death?
ai.summary: This introductory header establishes the historical moment of Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) final testament, delivered immediately after the fatal strike by Ibn Muljam, marking the transition from his caliphate to the era of the Imams. It underscores the gravity of his last instructions, which are viewed in Shia tradition as a crucial political and spiritual legacy guiding the community after his martyrdom.
